scope:
Inventory actual axle-bearing parts and check whether their rings start on bed.

This distinguishes a vertical bore from a bore suspended above the print bed.
Other overhangs are measured and reported, not waived as bridgeable.

limitations: An annular bed-contact screen of detected native-axle interfaces, not an exhaustive hole-feature recognizer.
Vertical holes with bed-supported rings do not imply the rest of a part is support-free. Unsupported surface area is reported separately.
Assembly access, material strength and bore fit require separate validation.
